remediation: Keep MT payloads inside the payment gateway and render a masked summary to the client.

scopeT: A response body that carries a SWIFT MT block with its field tags.
fp: A page that documents MT field numbers without values is not reported.
recordDesc: A SWIFT MT block with its field tags in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message carries the ordering customer, the beneficiary account and the amount, so one response can disclose a whole cross-border payment rather than a single field.
applicability: Deployments that render a SWIFT MT block with its field tags into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message carries the ordering customer, the beneficiary account and the amount, so one response can disclose a whole cross-border payment rather than a single field.
why: The marker exists for the build or administrator and answers a question an attacker would otherwise have to guess.
fix: Keep MT payloads inside the payment gateway and render a masked summary to the client.
Keep MT payloads inside the gateway and render a masked summary.
verifyT: Request the page again and confirm the response no longer carries a SWIFT MT block with its field tags.

title: PIN block in a response

remediation: Never serialise PIN material outside the HSM boundary and rotate the key that protected it.
limitation: One response body, first 32,768 bytes. It matches the PIN block field; it cannot tell whether the value behind the marker is live or whether the page needs authentication.
scopeT: A response body that carries a PIN block field carrying encrypted or clear PIN material.

applicability: Deployments that render a PIN block field carrying encrypted or clear PIN material into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A PIN block is the only secret behind a card at an ATM, and once it is out of the switch the holder's PIN can be recovered or replayed against a terminal.
why: The marker exists for the build or administrator and answers a question an attacker would otherwise have to guess.
fix: Never serialise PIN material outside the HSM boundary and rotate the key that protected it.
Keep PIN material inside the HSM boundary and rotate the protecting key.
verifyT: Request the page again and confirm the response no longer carries a PIN block field carrying encrypted or clear PIN material.

remediation: Never store or transmit full track data; keep only the token from the payment network.

recordDesc: Magnetic stripe track data with its sentinel format in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Full track data contains the PAN, the expiry and the cardholder name in the clear, which is exactly what a card-present fraud tool needs to clone the stripe.
applicability: Deployments that render magnetic stripe track data with its sentinel format into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Full track data contains the PAN, the expiry and the cardholder name in the clear, which is exactly what a card-present fraud tool needs to clone the stripe.
why: The marker exists for the build or administrator and answers a question an attacker would otherwise have to guess.
fix: Never store or transmit full track data; keep only the token from the payment network.
Never store or transmit full track data; keep the network token only.
verifyT: Request the page again and confirm the response no longer carries magnetic stripe track data with its sentinel format.

Keep bureau data in the credit engine and return only the decision.
